name: Fire Rod Fire
description: A fire projectile created by the Fire Rod.
InternalName: プレイヤーロッドの火

fields.name: Player Index
fields.description: Selects the player used by player-related checks.

fields.name: Direction
fields.description: Selects the direction of positional offsets.

fields.name: Behavior Mode
fields.description: Selects the projectile's behavior and lifecycle.

fields.name: Option Flag
fields.description: An option whose purpose is not yet determined.

fields.name: Behavior Option
fields.description: Affects initialization and bounds or collision setup. Value 2 has a special handling path in behavior mode 0.

fields.name: Collision Response
fields.description: Changes collision handling in behavior modes 3 and 4.
